title: "After the day"
aliases:
  - /tracks/one-day-replication/after.html
---
A single day has room for the three Rs on one claim and little else. The [companion curriculum](../../companion/index.qmd) covers what the day could only mention, in modules that each stand on their own, so take the one you need and leave the rest.

| If you want | Read |
|---|---|
| To deposit, version and register work of your own | [Reproducibility repositories](../../companion/repositories.qmd), then [Git and GitHub](../../companion/git-github.qmd) |
| To find the data for a project of your own, or to obtain the data behind this one | [Social science data sources](../../companion/data-sources.qmd) |
| The second R in depth: what happens to the result when the choices of an analysis change | [The multiverse and its critics](../../companion/multiverse.qmd), and [Reading a specification curve](../../cases/eu-frames/reading-inference.qmd) |
| The causal graph that Part 2 left optional | [Causal graphs](../../companion/dags.qmd) |
| The R behind the reproduction, and the document format of the workspace | [Getting started with R](../../companion/intro-r.qmd) and [Quarto and reproducible documents](../../companion/quarto.qmd) |
| How the panel was built from the survey files | [Building the analysis file](../../companion/data-management.qmd) |

The other formats of the course take the same case in other directions: the [data-tools day](../eu-frames-one-day-data-tools/index.qmd) gives the time of this day to R, the IDE, data management and version control, the [methods day](../eu-frames-one-day-methods/index.qmd) gives it to the statistics and to the menu of alternative analyses, and the [three-day course](../eu-frames-three-days/index.qmd) builds the data from the raw survey files and reproduces all five analysts.
